reprocess_generate_output: parse a generate.py translation output file into source, hypothesis, score, target, and pos_score dictionaries
reprocess_nbest_interactive_output: parse an interactive.py nbest output file into source, hypothesis, score, target, and pos_score dictionaries
write_reprocessed_hypotheses: write nbest hypotheses to separate source, hypothesis, and target output files for rescoring
get_score_from_pos: compute aggregate scores from per-position score dictionaries with optional prefix length or fraction filtering
parse_lm_eval_output: parse the output of eval_lm into sentences, scores, positional scores, and BPE token counts
